分享原卷｜第33題

完整原題

作答所需文章／材料

If you plan to travel between the small islands, you will be interested in the following news. After the flight between Northern Daisy Island and Lily Island started in March this year, there will be two more flight routes next year. One flight route is between Lily Island and Rose Island. You can travel between the two islands without going back to Northern Daisy Island first. The other new route starting next year is between Southern Daisy Island and Rose Island. Instead of taking a sea bus for more than five hours, you can spend much less time flying between the two islands. It will be much more convenient for you because it saves both time and money. To have more people experience the new flight to Rose Island, the tickets during the first three months of next year will be on sale online. The price may be up to 40% off. If you plan to have a vacation and enjoy the famous hot springs on Rose Island, don't forget to book the tickets as soon as possible. 原卷詞註：flight 航班；route 路線；instead 代替。 原圖標示Northern Daisy Island、Southern Daisy Island、Lily Island、Rose Island；紅點與連線表示Flight routes，New標示新航線，完整路網見下方作答附圖。

詳細說明與解題步驟

一、先分清三個時間
北Daisy—Lily在「今年3月」才開航，因此去年不能有這條線。明年再新增Lily—Rose、南Daisy—Rose兩條線，去年也不能有它們。

二、由原圖倒推
先從未來路網去掉今年新增的北Daisy—Lily，再去掉明年兩條標New航線。留下去年既有的北Daisy—南Daisy、北Daisy—Rose，對應圖D。

三、排除其餘路網
A仍含北Daisy—Lily等較晚開通航線；B保留Lily連線與南Daisy—Rose，不合去年；C同樣保留今年才開的北Daisy—Lily。D的Lily沒有航線連接，才與開航時間一致。不能把題幹last year看成this year或next year。

1 去年只有既有的兩條線

把時間退回去年，Lily尚未開航；原有北Daisy—南Daisy及北Daisy—Rose。

2 今年3月才連到Lily

文章說this year March新增北Daisy—Lily，因此去年不能保留這條。

3 明年再加兩條新線

next year才增加Lily—Rose與南Daisy—Rose，兩條都不屬去年路網。

④ 依去年今年明年還原航線

答案D：Lily沒有航線

  • 從未來路網刪去今年與明年的新線，留下D。新製概念路網保留連接關係，不冒充原地形圖。
